photo.alt: Vertical rectangle Pin Back Button with an illustration of a pink triangle and two purple triangles overlaying the capital of an Ionic column.
photo.description: Pin Back Button with an illustration of a pink triangle and two purple triangles overlaying the capital of an Ionic column Minnesota Queer Student Conference 1994 Conference held at the University of Minnesota, Twin Cities Campus.
